cc:Work.dc:title: figure2_information_characterization
cc:Work.dc:description: Figure 2. Spatial task-relevant ultrasonic information and sparse retention. (a) Equal-domain CAI-ratio MAE for matched scalar, full-field, and registered 25% sparse representations; the sparse representation retains 89.9% of the full-field gain. (b,c) Hash-verified reconstructions of specimen c8-2 at the 3.13% initial scout state and 25% uniform state; teal pixels mark measured native-raster positions. (d) Retrospective exact-cost mechanical oracle improvements over uniform and reconstruction acquisition. (e) Strict-OOF teacher priorities evolve over normalized cost. (f) Value-rank agreement varies with the downstream predictor. Aggregate intervals are synchronized specimen-bootstrap contrasts where shown.
